# #614 — Full bun test run against the shared dogfood DB is untrustworthy as a gate

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: bug
Created: 2026-08-07T23:03:29Z
Updated: 2026-08-07T23:03:29Z

---

## Problem

Running the full \`bun test\` suite against the shared dogfood database produces unstable failure counts on UNMODIFIED code (observed 49 → 43 → 40 across consecutive runs, 2026-08-06; same pattern as #498). Meanwhile the #609 lane's full-suite runs against a **freshly created** database were clean: \`origin/main\` 3701 pass / 0 fail.

## Implication

- A red full-suite run on the dogfood DB is not evidence a change is broken; a green one is not proof it is safe. Lanes currently compensate with differential failure-set comparison, which is labor and judgment per lane.
- The clean fresh-DB baseline shows the tests themselves are fine — the shared mutable state is the contaminant.

## Ask

Make the trustworthy path the default: test harness creates/points at an isolated database (as CI's \`db-integration\` job and the #609 lane's worktree runs already do) instead of the live dogfood DB. Documented in AGENTS.md once the mechanism lands.

Related: #498 (chunk-write flake, same class), #613 (one concrete leakage mechanism).
